content.short: Tonkeeper is the most popular non-custodial wallet for the TON blockchain, offering a seamless interface for managing assets.
content.description: Tonkeeper, the leading non-custodial wallet on The Open Network (TON), provides users with a secure and intuitive platform to store, send, and receive Toncoin. It supports a wide range of features including NFT management, integrated token swaps, and a built-in dApp browser for seamless interaction with the TON ecosystem. Known for its user-friendly design and robust security, Tonkeeper has become the primary gateway for millions of users to access decentralized finance and services on TON.
content.meta: Discover Tonkeeper, the leading non-custodial wallet for TON. Manage assets, NFTs, and dApps securely on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
